source: cannabinoids_test.go:TestCannabinoidAttribution ("balanced 1:1 bare ratio splits (Cannabryl ground truth)" + "'Nmg of CBD' wording + per-drop distractors")

raw.title: Cannabryl - 4000 mg - 1:1 - Premium
raw.description: The 1:1 ratio of CBD and THC is all set to deliver amazing health effects.

regression_note: An EQUAL bare ratio (1:1) needs no dominant-cannabinoid orientation at all — splits 50/50 whenever both cannabinoids are textually 'in play'. This is the fix for '4000mg 1:1 listed as CBD-only' — before the equal-ratio special case, an unoriented bare ratio with no determinable dominant fell through to a single-cannabinoid guess. cannabryl.com is a custom-platform scraper (all its products are prescription-required/THC-dominant per harvest/scrapers' deferred-store notes) so this exact product is a real, still-relevant catalogue case even though its store scraper is deferred past the PoC.
